result.description: Fires on the last word of a tech term like "Machine Learning" or "Virtual/augmented reality", and sometimes on "AI", when listed in a coordinated series of emerging technologies, often just before an acronym in parentheses. Silent on other "machine learning" uses.
result.label: Machine learning / reality in tech lists

result.description: Fires on the standalone word-initial token ' l' when it begins a longer word, mostly 'lymph' in anatomy text and also 'lens' or 'laminar'. Predicts continuation pieces like 'ign', 'amin', 'anth'.
result.label: word-initial ' l' (lymph, lens)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ur' in the middle of a word, mostly after 'pl' in "plurals", "plurality", "plurilingual". Also fires inside other words like bifurcation and heuristic, and predicts a continuing suffix.
result.label: 'ur' piece in pl-ur words

result.description: Fires on the word " consent" (occasionally " compatibility"/" compatible") in data, privacy and ethics text. Members include consent detectors and privacy-related pieces like "acy", "confidentiality" and "authentication". Weakly predicts "ing" or "with" next.
result.label: ' consent' in privacy/data ethics

result.description: Diffuse target firing on varied function words and verbs (' the', ' that', ' corresponds', ' access') inside abstract, technical expository prose, mostly after "that"-clauses; predicts abstract nouns like intent, plan, target. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Abstract technical prose function words

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb (are/is/was/'re/actually) right after a "what/who + subject" embedded clause, e.g. "what the author is trying", where a verb like saying/doing/trying comes next. Silent on "they are" in plain statements.
result.label: Aux verb in what-you-are clauses

result.description: Fires on function words and connectives (and, of, on, for, measures, commas) right after metric terms like accuracy, precision, recall in evaluation or measurement text, where a measurement-related word is expected next. Silent on 'and' in other science contexts.
result.label: Function words after precision/accuracy metrics

result.description: Fires on the capital ' S' as a word-initial piece of a proper name, mainly in language and region names (Sino-, Southeast, Slavic, Sinitic, Sumerian, Scythian). It predicts continuations like 'out', 'umer', 'ansk'.
result.label: Capital S starting language/region names

result.description: Fires on an opening quote mark (' or ") that begins the next quoted item in a list of quoted words, such as prepositions or pronouns ('at', 'by', 'on'). Silent in ordinary prose without such quoted lists.
result.label: Opening quote in quoted word lists

result.description: Fires on scattered word fragments, odd byte pieces and rare tokens (' campion', 'rä', 'AR', 'buf', 'ühr') with no shared meaning. Members are token-piece detectors. Peak consistency is low and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered rare token fragments

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'log' inside "syllogism" (also 'istic' in "statistic", ' literally'), a mid-word fragment in logic/statistics text. Silent on 'log' at the start of a document, so it needs a preceding word piece.
result.label: 'log' in syllogism / statistic pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ili' in "res|ili|ence", after "res" in the word resilience. It predicts the continuation 'ence'. Weaker activations occur on similar mid-word pieces such as ' flu' in fluency.
result.label: 'ili' in resilience

result.description: Fires on ' mirror' used as a metaphor noun after "serves/acts as a", as in art or literature being a mirror of society. It is silent on the verb use "also mirrors societal…".
result.label: metaphorical "as a mirror"

result.description: Fires on reporting verbs after a research or study subject (shown, revealed, highlighted, indicates, demonstrated), where a finding is about to be stated. It pushes toward "that" or "significant".
result.label: Research-finding verbs like "shown"

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece ' sp' (also 'cement' in 'placement') when a continuation like 'anning', 'elling' or 'ont' is expected, especially in "period, spanning from". Silent on ' sp' in 'spices' after 'herbs or'.
result.label: ' sp' piece predicting 'anning'

result.description: Fires on plural setting nouns (areas, regions, systems, states, spaces) right after a modifier in an "in [adjective] X" phrase, such as "in dry areas" or "in solid states". It is silent on "various areas" or "all areas". Predicts "such", "like".
result.label: Setting nouns after "in ADJ"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' vent' (also ' conject', ' file') when it is an incomplete word start, as in "venturing" or "ventures", predicting a suffix like "ure". Members are vent/Vent detectors and other word-start pieces that predict "ure".
result.label: ' vent' word-start before -ure

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lex' inside 'reflex-' words (reflexive, reflexivity, reflexively). It stays silent on 'lex' at the very start of a document, where there is no 'ref' before it.
result.label: 'lex' in 'reflexive'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ic' completing "organic" (mostly "organic matter/material" in soil text). It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as authigenic, endogenic and mutagenic. It pushes towards "matter".
result.label: 'ic' in "organic"

result.description: Fires on the word " film" (as in filmmakers, film scoring, film production), predicting compounds like making, maker, director, scoring. Members are mostly film/entertainment/animation detectors. The contrast shows no clear example of silence on the token.
result.label: ' film' before making/maker/scoring

result.description: Fires on varied word-ending tokens (care, ers, els, cities, changes, market) inside economic or business-benefit text, such as tourism, jobs and retail. It stays silent on 'market' in 'marketing'. Low consistency, mixed evidence.
result.label: Plural/noun endings in economic-benefit text

result.description: Fires on function words and commas (",", " and", " of", " the") inside explanatory text about software maintenance and engineering processes, where a list of tasks or activities is continuing. Silent on commas in other technical or general text.
result.label: Commas in software maintenance task lists
paved (the way) word piece
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'aved' in "paved the way/road" (also 'aving', 'ited' in "credited"), mostly in academic history or science text about developments paving the way. Members are detectors of 'aved'/'aving'/'ave'.

Fires on the word " financial" (also the "cial" piece of "Financial") as a modifier before a noun like institutions, services, crisis or stability. Silent on the Great Depression contrast text, which has no such word.
result.label: ' financial' modifier word

result.description: Fires on the token " person" (also "Person"), often as a word stem before suffixes like -ification, -ality, or in "first/third person". Predicts suffix pieces such as 'ality' and 'hood'. Upstream members are mostly " person" detectors.
result.label: ' person' token detector
'end' piece in 'bend'
result.description: Fires on the 'end' token (also 'ends', 'ending') when it completes the word 'bend', mainly in physics text about light or sound bending. It also fires on 'end' inside words like 'dendritic'.

Fires on a noun ending a phrase of the form "X's history/past/life/usage/over time", where a domain noun completes a noun phrase. It often predicts "such", "including" or "that" next. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Noun ending a domain phrase (history/time)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and punctuation (commas, 'for', 'describe', 'that') in expository prose about lists or concepts, mid-clause where a continuation follows. Peak tokens are mixed and the circuit is weak, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Mixed function words in expository lists

result.description: Fires on the prefixes " macro" and " micro" (also " Micro") when they begin a compound word, such as macroeconomic, microscale or microstate. It predicts a continuation like "scop", "e" or "econ". Silent on ordinary economics text without these prefixes.
result.label: macro/micro prefix

result.description: Fires on the additive connector in "while also considering/examining", "as well as", and similar, where a further topic or analysis is being added to a list of things discussed. It stays silent on "such as", "serving as" and "operating as".
result.label: Additive "also/as well as" connector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " erg" before "onomic/onomics" (mostly mid-sentence). Weaker on other word-start pieces like " Ly", " Arist", "semi". It predicts word-continuation pieces. Silent on the capitalized "Ergonomics" at sentence start.
result.label: " erg" prefix of ergonomic

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ain' in "unattainable" (also "attainment"), and weakly on ' opp' and some commas. It stays silent on 'ain' in "sustainable" or "Maintain", so it needs the unatt-/att- word.
result.label: 'ain' in unattainable

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Princi' (mostly in "X Principle" names like Uncertainty or Pauli Exclusion Principle), and weaker on ' per' (perception) and ' pur', where a completion like -ple or -ception comes next.
result.label: Princi- / per- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token 'e' when it is split off as a prefix piece before 'conomic', as in macro-e-conomic, micro-e-conomic and socio-e-conomic. It predicts 'conom' next. Members are mostly 'e' detectors.
result.label: 'e' in macro-e-conomic

result.description: Fires on the word piece "au" inside names and terms like "tau" (tau neutrino, tau lepton) and "Landau". Weakly fires on "arma" in "pharmaceutical". Upstream members are mostly "au" detectors.
result.label: "au" word piece (tau, Landau)

result.description: Fires on the word " different" (also in "differentiation"), mostly as a modifier before a plural noun, as in "between different cultures". Predicts "iation", "types" or "kinds" next. Upstream members are mostly " different" detectors.
result.label: ' different' token detector

result.description: Fires on function words (the, of, with, for) right after a verb or predicate describing what syntax or semantics deals with, in linguistics text. It predicts linguistic nouns such as Syntax, clause, sentence. Silent on 'on the' in generic contexts.
result.label: Function words in linguistics definitions

result.description: Fires on the "actions" piece in "re|actions" (also " reaction") in chemistry text, especially after "chemical". It stays silent in some contexts such as "parasitic reactions" and "redox reactions".
result.label: chemical "reactions" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "oul" inside "Coulomb"/"Coulometry" (also Bernoulli), after an initial capital C or Bern. It predicts a continuation like "omb". Rare weak firing elsewhere.
result.label: "oul" in Coulomb/Bernoulli

result.description: Fires on the verb or article right after "communication" as the subject of an opening definitional sentence (" is", " a", " an", " has"). Silent on the same words when the subject isn't communication.
result.label: Verb after "Communication" subject

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' m', ' d', ' g', ' syn' that start a longer word, mostly in text about errors or miscommunication. It predicts continuations such as 'ish', 'istr' and 'itch' (mishaps, mistrust).
result.label: Word-start fragment 'm' before mis- words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "electro" (or "Elect|ro") as the start of a chemistry or physics compound such as electrolyte, electrode or electrostatic. It predicts continuations like "static", "chem" and "weak".
result.label: electro- prefix in chemistry words

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of scientific words, mostly 'gener' in "neurodegenerative", also ' mechan' and similar stems. Members detect biology/chemistry word-pieces and stems like Conserv-, deriv-, discrimin-.
result.label: Mid-word science stems, 'gener'

result.description: Fires on the 'als' piece completing "metals" (met + als), in text about metals and materials. It stays silent on 'als' in other words such as "Waals" and "reveals".
result.label: 'als' ending "metals"

result.description: Fires on plural-selecting quantifier/determiner words (different, various, multiple, all, certain, these) before a plural noun, in abstract text about writing, language and texts. Silent on some 'different' cases, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Variety quantifiers before plural nouns

result.description: Fires on varied words (financial, capital, international, border) in finance and international-business text, where the next word is expected to be an economic noun like trade or investment. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Finance/international modifier before economic noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece " out" used as a prefix at the start of a longer word, as in outpace, outnumbered, outcomes, outbreak, outliers. It predicts word continuations like pace, comes, break, lines.
result.label: " out" as word-initial prefix

result.description: Fires weakly on varied connective words (then, with, and, by) and word pieces in instructional or technical step-by-step text, such as methods and procedures. Peaks are inconsistent and the same tokens often stay silent, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Connectives in technical procedural text

result.description: Fires on the copula ' is'/' are' (also 'being', 'be') right after an abstract noun subject such as outcome, variable, probability or computation, in technical or definitional text. It predicts a verb or adverb like 'assign', 'calculated' or 'often'.
result.label: Copula after abstract technical subject
' the' in abstract philosophy questions
result.description: Fires on ' the' (rarely ' its') right after a verb or preposition introducing an abstract topic, such as questioning, scrutinizing, or questions about, in philosophy and academic text. It stays quiet on ' the' elsewhere, such as after a comma or at a clause start.

Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ular' in "secular" and "modular" and 'icon' in "semiconductors", where the word continues with a suffix. It stays silent on 'ular' in "vernacular". The evidence is mixed and the logits are unclear.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'ular'/'icon' (secular)

result.description: Fires on a field-of-study noun (arts, engineering, art, business) right after "In (the realm of) ..." at the start of a document, in an academic-domain opener. Silent when the same word appears mid-sentence, not in that opening slot.
result.label: Field noun after "In ..." opener

result.description: Fires on the last digit of a four-digit year (e.g. 1925, 1796) when it is attributed to a person's work, as in "Stein's 1925 paper" or "his 1950 article". Predicts a work noun like paper, theory or book next.
result.label: Final year digit before a work

result.description: Fires on a concrete noun (well, junction, processor, image, drill, hole) ending a noun phrase after "the", often in technical text. Predicts a following possessive, "itself", or surface-like noun. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Technical noun before possessive/itself

result.description: Fires on the word ' charge' in physics text about electric or color charge (total charge, types of charge, charge density). Predicts continuations like carriers, distributions, conjugation. Members are mostly earlier ' charge' detectors.
result.label: Physics 'charge' token

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' trom' (as in trombone), and sometimes ' susp' (suspension), when a longer word is being split into pieces. Members detect instrument-name fragments and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' trom' fragment of trombone

result.description: Fires on the word " random" (also Random, randomly) in statistics and ML text, such as random sampling, randomization and random subspaces. It pushes toward suffixes like -ness, -ized, -ization and toward " sampling". Silent on related words like entropy.
result.label: " random" token detector

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word (bl-, foc-, expos-, v-) in photography and optics text, such as depth of field, focal length and blurring. Members are photography and art topic detectors plus word-start detectors.
result.label: Word-start pieces in photography text

result.description: Fires on the "ate" piece completing "substr|ate" (enzyme substrate), especially before words like concentration or type. It stays silent on "ate" in other words such as pyruvate, phosphate, initiate and culminate.
result.label: "ate" in "substrate"

result.description: Fires on the end of a measurable physical quantity term in science headings (Dens-ity, Intens-ity, Bond L-ength, width, speed, density), where a measurement or calculation is expected next. Silent on 'ity' in other nouns like viscosity or ubiquity.
result.label: Measurable quantity noun endings

result.description: Fires on varied function words (to, of, in, beyond, quote marks) in texts about grammar and gender-neutral or singular "they" pronouns. It stays silent on many identical "to" tokens in other contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words in gender-grammar text

result.description: Fires on plural person nouns like ' people' or ' individuals' as the subject of a clause, mostly right after 'that', 'how' or 'when', where a verb comes next. It stays silent on 'people' at the start of a text.
result.label: People/individuals as clause subject

result.description: Fires on the final word piece of a surname (e.g. 'orth' in Wordsworth, 'di' in Vivaldi) in a list of famous people after "poets like" or "artists such as". Likely predicts a following name separator or suffix.
result.label: Surname-ending piece in famous-name lists

result.description: Fires on geometric region nouns like " plane", " surface", " interval", " point" in math text (calculus, geometry, vector fields), where the noun names a space or domain being integrated over or located in. Silent on casual "place" uses.
result.label: Math geometric domain nouns (plane, surface)

result.description: Fires on ' such' right after a plural noun like "issues" or "treatments", where "such as" introduces examples. Silent on 'such' in "of such innovative approaches" and similar. Pushes toward problem nouns such as errors and crashes.
result.label: ' such' introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' ge' (or ' Ge') that begins geo- words like geography, geology, geophysics, in earth-science lists. Predicts continuations such as 'ographical', 'ological', 'och'. Silent on some sentence-initial or "political/cultural ge" cases.
result.label: ' ge' start of geo- words

result.description: Fires mostly on ' corner' in "cornerstone" (e.g. "the corner|stone of"), predicting 'stone'. Also weakly on scattered tokens such as '/' in dates, 'ative', and 'front' in "forefront". The circuit is mostly corner detectors.
result.label: corner of "cornerstone"

result.description: Fires on varied function words (of, the, these, this, with) in text about classifying or grouping things into classes, genera, or categories. It predicts next tokens like "classification", "categories", "subclass", "each". Silent on "of" in generic descriptive phrases.
result.label: Function words in classification text

result.description: Fires on " international" / " International" (also " global"), strongest as a capitalized heading word at the start of a topic title like "International Trade". Pushes toward affairs, relations, commerce and diplomacy.
result.label: International / global (trade, relations)

result.description: Fires on ' consider' when it is the stem of the noun "considerations" (after a modifier like ethical, safety, ergonomic), predicting the "-ations" suffix. Silent when ' consider' is the verb (should consider, we consider).
result.label: consider- stem of "considerations"

result.description: Fires on connectors (as, and, like, from, in) that introduce or continue a list of animal examples in text about predators and animal species. Silent on the same connectors in non-animal contexts. Predicts animal-related continuations.
result.label: Connectors before animal example lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word or mid-phrase pieces that precede a continuation: 'ymn' in gymnastics, ' Life' in 'Software Development Life Cycle', ' unit' in 'per unit', 'itions' in prepositions. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Incomplete word/phrase fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' Sh', ' of', 'atic', ' listener', ' environment') mostly in abstract academic or scientific prose, especially chemistry-like text. Peaks are inconsistent, and members are mostly generic attention latents with no clear shared token.
result.label: Scattered tokens in technical prose

result.description: Fires on ' to' as an infinitive marker of purpose after a tool/agent noun (models, engineers, analytics, tools) in analytical or engineering text, predicting action verbs like calculate, analyze, advance. Silent after 'challenge you', 'leading to', 'crucial to', 'ability to'.
result.label: purpose infinitive 'to' after tools

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and adverb pieces (' be', ' as', ' just', '-ly') in abstract, essay-style philosophical or religious prose, where an adjective, adverb or predicate is expected next. Silent on many ' be' tokens elsewhere.
result.label: Abstract-prose predicate-slot function words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' fant' (fantasy) and ' inqu'/' enqu' (inquiry) that begin a longer word after an adjective or noun, mid-sentence. Silent when ' fant' opens the document. Members mostly detect ' inqu'.
result.label: fant-/inqu- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on ' plants', 'ician' (Ordovician) and similar words ending a noun phrase in text about prehistoric life, paleontology and early evolution (vascular plants, life forms). Silent on ' plants' in other contexts like ecology or general plant talk.
result.label: Paleozoic life-history nouns (plants, Ordovician)

result.description: Fires on ' and'/' or'/commas right after a list of time units (days, weeks, months, years), where another time unit or "even ..." item is expected. It is quiet on 'and' after other kinds of lists or clauses.
result.label: Conjunction after time-unit lists

result.description: Fires on words in a comparison with a conventional or earlier counterpart ("unlike its", "over conventional", "its syntactical counterpart"). It seems to predict "counter", "predecessors" or "ones". It is silent on ordinary ' the'.
result.label: Contrast with counterpart or predecessor

result.description: Fires on function words (in, a, whether, to, with) in technical physics/science text, especially around moment of inertia, where the next word is likely a technical term. Silent on some ' in' tokens in other engineering contexts. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Function words in physics explanations
"dishes" plural in food text
result.description: Fires on the "ishes" piece completing "dishes" (d-ishes) in cooking and food writing, e.g. "create dishes that reflect...". Members are food, menu, recipe and ingredient detectors plus other "ishes" detectors. It predicts words like "prepared" and "made".

Fires on the word ' traffic' (road traffic, signals, congestion, management) in transportation or traffic-control text. It predicts continuations like flow, lights, routing and management. The contrast is a network-isolation passage with no road traffic.
result.label: ' traffic' in road/traffic control

result.description: Fires mostly on the mid-word piece 'mos' in "Atmospheric" at the start of a document or heading. It also fires weakly on other mid-word pieces such as 'ized', 'rive' and 'ural'. The circuit is diffuse and mixed.
result.label: 'mos' in Atmospheric (word piece)

result.description: Fires on technology/design nouns (' design', ' technology', 'techn-ologies/ological') used as modifiers in noun phrases, e.g. "requirements or design specifications", "changing technology trends". Predicts a following plural noun like requirements or details. Silent on 'software design' as a head topic.
result.label: design/technology modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on the word " interpretation" as a noun, in analytical or scientific text (data, spectra, art, meaning). Members are mostly detectors of "interpret/interpretation" tokens. It stays silent on contrast text without the word.
result.label: ' interpretation' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " visual" itself, mostly as an adjective in arts, media and communication text (visual art, visual narratives, visual cues). Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same token. Logits are not clear.
result.label: ' visual' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (-ing, -es, -ed, or "rich") completing the verb "enrich", e.g. "enriching", "enriches". Silent on -ing after other verbs. Predicts objects like "our", "lives", "the".
result.label: suffix completing "enrich" verb

result.description: Fires on a word-start fragment (e.g. 'c' in trans-c-ends, ' el', ' enc', ' ep') after a subject noun, where a third-person verb like "transcends/elucidates/epitomizes" is being spelled out; predicts verb stem endings (-itated, -iled). Silent on some 'c' in similar words.
result.label: Mid-word verb stem fragment

result.description: Fires on list separators (' and', commas, ' as', abbreviation openers) within enumerations of technical or scientific terms, such as hydrology processes or neural network types. It stays silent on many other list 'and' tokens, so the extra condition is unclear.
result.label: List separators in technical enumerations

result.description: Fires on auxiliary verbs (is/are/be, sometimes "then") right after a plural or mass noun for a substance or supply (oxygen, nutrients, supplies), in a passive slot predicting verbs like distributed, transferred, supplied. Silent on "is" before adjectives or predicates.
result.label: Passive auxiliary after transported substance

result.description: Fires on connectors (' and', ' over', ' while', ' with', '-') right after "short-term" or "long", where the next word is expected to be "long/longer/long-lasting". Silent on ' and' after other words.
result.label: Connector after short-term, predicting long

result.description: Fires on " the" (or "comparing") right after verbs like evaluate/assess in definitions of cost-benefit analysis, where the next word is likely "cost"/"benefits". Silent on "the" in other evaluation contexts.
result.label: "the" before cost-benefit terms

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in wind, climate and geography text, such as "Southern", "west" in northwest, "rose" in compass rose, and "Lat" in Horse Latitudes. It seems to anticipate a following word about flows or circulation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Wind and compass-direction terms

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens (' population', ' to', ' of', Cyrillic 'но') mostly in genetics and evolution text about gene flow and alleles. It is silent on ' population' in ecology or health contexts. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Gene-flow text, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " sentiment" (also "iment" in sentiment-like pieces), most strongly when it is the first word of "sentiment analysis/classification/scores" in NLP text. Weak activity on a few other word pieces.
result.label: "sentiment" before analysis

result.description: Fires on the token " reporting" as a noun modifier in compliance or business text (e.g. "mandatory reporting", "reporting standards"). Many members are reporting detectors. It pushes toward "on", "requirements", "reported".
result.label: ' reporting' noun-modifier token

result.description: Fires on plural nouns for connections or pathways (networks, channels, routes) right after a modifier like "trade" or "exchange", mostly in trade and exchange text. Weaker on similar plurals such as paths and mechanisms.
result.label: Trade/exchange networks, channels, routes

result.description: Fires mainly on the word ' intellect' (also 'iz' in Leibniz, 'und', 'ly') in Enlightenment/humanism-style text, where the next piece is likely a suffix such as 'uals' or 'ually'. Silent on the philosophy-of-mind contrast text.
result.label: ' intellect' in Enlightenment text

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix 'ist' completing "minimalist" (also ' column', ' multip', 'mos' in weaker cases). Silent on 'ist' after other stems like Marx-, Real-, Faulv-. Predicts art-movement continuations.
result.label: 'ist' in minimalist

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a mathematician's name split into word pieces, mostly ' Hil' in "Hilbert space", also ' Lie' and 'uther'. It predicts the continuation piece (e.g. 'bert'). Silent when "Hilbert" starts the document.
result.label: Hil- of Hilbert (math name start)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and verbs (to, of, as, the, considering, convey) in abstract expository prose, mostly where a content word or noun phrase is expected next. Peaks are inconsistent and the same tokens stay silent elsewhere, so the trigger is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires on varied word-ending or function pieces (-ness, -ing, -ier, ' of', passing, coming) in abstract expository text, often where a noun like changes, variations or connections could follow. Silent on ' of' after nouns like set, aspect, representations.
result.label: Suffix and 'of' before change-nouns

result.description: Fires on the adjective " fundamental" before a noun like aspect, component, principle or concept, as in "a fundamental aspect of". Members are mostly detectors of the same token, plus similar adjectives (essential, pivotal, radical).
result.label: ' fundamental' adjective detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' her' when it is the split-off first piece of "heritage", mostly after "cultural" or "intangible". It predicts the continuation "itage". It stays silent when "heritage" starts the text, and pronoun uses of ' her' are not the peaks.
result.label: ' her' as start of 'heritage'

result.description: Fires on the end of an adjective (-ical, -atic, -ential, -ious, 'complex', 'significant') in the slot after "take(s)/play a (more/increasingly) ADJ", just before "approach/role/steps". Silent on the same suffix in other uses, such as "democratic process".
result.label: Adjective before 'approach/role' after take/play

result.description: Fires on varied function words and tokens (' (', ' down', ' tasks', ' with', ' is') inside academic or methodology text about task analysis, testing, and teaching. Peaks are mixed; the topic seems to matter more than the token. Weakly predicts words like 'simulation' and 'interactive'.
result.label: Task-analysis and methodology text, varied tokens

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' deriv' (as in "derivation") in linguistics/word-formation text, plus similar mid-word pieces like 'iv' and 'liqu'. Silent on other word-formation text without that piece.
result.label: 'deriv' of derivation, linguistics

result.description: Fires on the token " her" (pronoun and as the start of words like "herbs", "heritage", "herding"). Predicts word continuations such as "itage", "bs", "ald", "ring" more than ordinary possessive continuations.
result.label: " her" token, word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and modifiers (' to', ' through', ' by', commas, adjectives like 'significant') mid-clause, where the next word is an open continuation. It stays silent on many ' to' tokens, so the pattern is mixed and unclear.
result.label: Scattered mid-clause function words

result.description: Fires on commas and conjunctions (' and', ',', ' or', ' as') inside a list of examples of structures or engineered objects, such as "bridges, towers", predicting the next list item (buildings, railway). Silent on commas in other lists.
result.label: List separators in engineering structure lists

result.description: Fires on the piece 'estone' completing the word "milestone" (e.g. "milestone points", "milestone descriptions"). Weakly fires on the related "ones" in "milestones". Members mostly detect 'estone' or milestone/step/breakthrough-like pieces.
result.label: 'estone' in milestone

result.description: Fires on verb pieces meaning "improve/increase", mainly "enh-ance/-ancing", plus " increasing" and "elevate", in writing about stories, plots and characters. It stays silent on "enhance" in other contexts and on non-verb "-ance" words like "resonance".
result.label: enhance/increase verb in narrative writing

result.description: Fires on the word piece " strateg" (as in strategic, strategies) inside the word. It is silent when " strateg" is the first token of the document. Upstream members are mostly detectors of strateg/ateg pieces.
result.label: ' strateg' word piece

result.description: Fires on the modifier piece in technical compound adjectives, mostly "time" in "real-time" and "speed" in "high-speed", where a noun like applications, systems or environments is expected next. Silent in at least one real-time rendering context.
result.label: Technical compound modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after "particularly" or "especially", introducing a domain or area ("particularly in areas such as"). Stays silent on ordinary ' in' after nouns. Pushes toward "regard", "relation", "terms".
result.label: ' in' after particularly/especially

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after 'of' (e.g. 'plight of the', 'complexity of the', 'index of refraction of the'), where a noun phrase follows. Silent on ' the' after verbs or other prepositions like 'before', 'reveal', 'remains'.
result.label: ' the' after 'of'

result.description: Fires on "Keep" or "stay" (also keep/maintain/hit) at the start of a "keep up / stay ahead / keep pace" phrase, especially sentence-initial or before "-ing". Pushes toward "ing", "updated", and "master".
result.label: Keep/stay ahead verb

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' to', ' for', ' can', 'than for') in explanatory academic text, where a verb or complement is expected next (aid, assist, able). Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, with no clear discriminating members.
result.label: Function words in expository text
' developers' after "allows"
result.description: Fires on ' developers' as the agent noun right after a verb like "allows/enables" (e.g. "allows developers to…") in software and programming text. Weakly fires on similar role nouns such as users or engineers.

result.label: 'as' inside "par-as-itic" word
result.description: Fires on the piece 'as' (occasionally 's') within the word "parasit-" (parasitic, parasitology, parasitism), after the piece "par". Silent on 'as' in other words like "peas" or a word-initial "asitism".

Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (words, in, the, their, of, for, with) in expository text about writing or analysis, where a noun like "these details" or "this" is likely next. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Mixed function words before demonstratives
'ition' in 'practitioners'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ition' inside 'practitioners' (pract|ition|ers), predicting the 'ers' ending. Weak activity on a few other mid-word pieces and ' trick'. Silent on ordinary text.

Fires on prepositions like "to", "by", "of" after words of change or response (due to, responding to, adjusts to, shifts in) in economics text. It predicts nouns such as "changing", "external", "market". Silent on "to" in other constructions.
result.label: Preposition after change/response in economics

result.description: Fires on the copula ' is' (also ' are', ' be') right after a subject noun naming a technique or concept, in generic essay-style sentences ("glazing is considered to be…"). Silent on "is" after "feedback" or a bare pronoun.
result.label: Copula after concept-noun subject

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' em' when it starts a longer word (empathy, emissions, emotion, emulsification), most strongly in "cognitive em|pathy". Predicts continuations like 'path', 'ulation', 'blem'. Silent on one "emotionally" example.
result.label: ' em' word-start piece (empathy)

result.description: Fires on the token 'u', both as a standalone math variable (u + v, u(x)) and as a letter inside words (Intuitionistic, vacuum, Altruism). Pushes toward continuations like 'ction', 'cc', 'istic', 'um'.
result.label: Letter 'u' token

result.description: Fires mainly on the prefix ' hyper' (as in hyperbole, hyperboxes), predicting word pieces like 'b'/'bol'. Also fires weakly on scattered tokens in garbled Cyrillic text (' все', 'о'), which is noisy.
result.label: ' hyper' prefix before 'bol'

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns like truth, meaning, thoughts, messages, intentions right after verbs or adjectives about uncovering or revealing hidden things (e.g. "reveal hidden thoughts", "uncover unspoken truths"). Silent on plain plot description.
result.label: Hidden meanings/truths being uncovered

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'sc' when it is the start of a split word such as land|sc|apes (also city|sc|apes), predicting continuations like 'apes', 'apers', 'aped'. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'sc' in landscapes

result.description: Fires on the token ' collaboration' in all 64 peak examples, mostly in workplace and software-tool contexts. It pushes next-token predictions towards 'tools', 'platforms', 'opportunities' and 'across'. Members are mostly collaboration and cooperation detectors.
result.label: ' collaboration' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' million' after a number, strongest in geological time spans (e.g. "485 million to", "250 million year"). Weaker for money or quantities. Next-token logits favor ' years' and similar units.
result.label: ' million' after number (geologic time)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Pro" (as in Probability) at the start of a line or title, especially in list-like headings of topics. Members are mostly detectors of Pro/pro tokens. Predicts continuations like "per", "pos", "bed".
result.label: ' Pro' word-start piece in headings

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and mid-sentence tokens (direct, language, and, of, equal, involves) in abstract expository prose about communication, society and academic topics. It predicts a following content noun, but the peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered words in abstract expository prose

result.description: Fires on causal conjunctions, mainly " because" (also " as", " since"), especially after an evaluative predicate like "is significant/important/critical", where a clause explaining why follows. Predicts a subject pronoun like "it" or "they".
result.label: Because after importance claims

result.description: Fires on word pieces like ' agre' (agreements), ' enfor', and 'support' mid-phrase in legal, trade and regulatory text, where the next token continues a legal/regulatory word. Silent when ' agre' starts a document.
result.label: Legal/trade word-piece 'agre' in context

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'experience', word pieces like 'sens-ory', 'pal-ate') mostly in abstract descriptive prose about dining or sensory experience. Silent on commas in reasoning/understanding text. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Dining/sensory experience prose, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on a single letter or short fragment that starts or continues an abbreviation or acronym, mainly the 'g' in "e.g.", capital 'N' or 'G' in acronyms (miRNAs, NGLP, GDPR) and 'ern' in names. It predicts acronym-like capital continuations.
result.label: Letters inside abbreviations and acronyms

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' and' in a coordination, word endings like -ification/-ation, and abbreviation pieces, in academic or expository text. Peaks are scattered, and ' and' is often silent on the contrast, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered 'and' and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on 'and', 'the', 'like', 'including' right before a named industrial-revolution invention (spinning jenny, power loom, steam engine) in lists of examples. Silent on 'and' joining abstract nouns elsewhere.
result.label: Connector before named industrial inventions

result.description: Fires on the token ' flow', most strongly in fluid dynamics text (laminar/turbulent flow, flow patterns, flow rate). Weaker for network flow or current flow. Predicts continuations like regime, conditions, patterns.
result.label: ' flow' in fluid dynamics

result.description: Fires on the 'ip' piece in "Antiparticles" (Ant-ip-articles), after "Ant"/"ant". It stays silent on 'ip' in "Multiplication", so it needs the anti- word-start context.
result.label: 'ip' inside Antiparticles

result.description: Fires on verbs like "providing", "provide", "add", "support" that introduce what something contributes (evidence, context, credibility), mostly in essays about how quotes, references or examples work. Predicts nouns like annotations, citations, explanations. Silent on "providing" in a general list context.
result.label: Contribution verbs: providing/add in essays

result.description: Fires on prepositions like " at" or " in" after verbs of amusement or enjoyment (chuckle at, find joy in, one can observe) in humor and playfulness writing, where a noun phrase such as "the thought of" comes next. Silent on " at" in other contexts.
result.label: Preposition after chuckle/joy in humor
Adjective suffix before manner noun
result.description: Fires on adjective-ending pieces (-ical, -ional, -ive, 'personal') in descriptive phrases in arts/essay text, where a noun like approach, manner, or perspective comes next. Silent on 'ional' in 'emotional' and 'intentional'.

Fires on the word " live" (also "Live") as an adjective/adverb meaning real-time or in-person, e.g. "live music", "live streaming", "goes live", "live migration". Pushes towards nouns like performances, sessions and events.
result.label: 'live' as real-time adjective

result.description: Fires on function words (the, to, of, by, for) in philosophy text, especially existentialism passages, just before an abstract philosophical term like "absurd" or "freedom". The same words are silent in other philosophy contexts.
result.label: Function words in existentialist philosophy text

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token right after a name or noun, where an 's' (possessive or contraction) is expected next. Strongest after disease eponyms and algorithm names (Huntington', Prim'). Quiet after some plural or abstract nouns.
result.label: Apostrophe after name before 's

result.description: Fires on the word "networks" (or "network") right after "neural", in machine learning text such as convolutional or recurrent neural networks. Members detect "neural" and "networks" tokens and related NN terms.
result.label: "networks" after "neural"

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, in, comma, to, 'ator') mid-sentence in technical science and engineering text, such as nuclear, fusion and physics. Predicts technical continuations. Silent on 'ator' in combinatorics/stator.
result.label: Technical-science function-word slot

result.description: Fires on prepositions and function words (to, for, with, about, in, how they) that follow a noun or verb about employees/people in workplace text, where a "their"/"safely"-type continuation about those people's actions is expected. Silent on infinitival "to" in other uses.
result.label: Function word after employee-related noun

result.description: Fires on ' (' that opens the next numbered item "(2)" in an inline enumerated list, after a separator like a comma or semicolon following "(1)". Silent on parentheses used for asides or examples; predicts the number "2".
result.label: Opening paren of next list number

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", and gerunds like "using"/"applying" that separate items in a list of writing or language techniques (e.g. "manipulating sentence length, blending…"). Predicts the next list item, such as a writing-technique noun.
result.label: List items in writing techniques

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period after abstract, technical or academic prose (science, materials, management), where a new sentence or paragraph begins next. Silent on periods in abbreviations like "e.g." or "etc."
result.label: Sentence-final period in expository text

result.description: Fires on the token " product" itself, mostly as a modifier before a noun (product development, features, analytics). Members are mostly " product" detectors. It also fires weakly on "product" in productivity. Silent on the contrast text, which has no "product" token.
result.label: ' product' token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ights' of the word "insights", mostly in business/data text ("actionable insights", "valuable insights into"). Members are 'ights'/'insight' detectors; the next token is often "into".
result.label: 'ights' completing "insights"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " trade"/" Trade", both in "trade-offs" and in commerce uses (trade policy, trade routes). Members are mostly detectors of this token. Occasional weak firing on digits and other tokens.
result.label: Word "trade" detector
